messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency above SLO for customer 'Aurora Retail' (vpc-aurora-eu-west). Current p99 = 4.6s (SLO 2.0s). Affected route: /v1/generate (dedicated-pool: aurora-pool-3). Pager: Sam Cho.
Sam Cho: Got it — I'm on the page. Starting a quick blast of metrics and recent deploys.
Priya Nair: I see a spike in request queue depth on aurora-pool-3 around 12:18UTC, and a concurrent bump in GPU memory pressure on host g-aurora-09.
Mateo Ruiz: I'm pulling host health. g-aurora-09 shows repeated OOM killer events for worker process (log snippet below). Suspect KV cache thrash after model rollout.
Mateo Ruiz: ```
[12:17:43] worker[pid=2145] OOMKilled - rss 28.3G > limit 28G
[12:17:44] worker restart
[12:18:01] cache miss spike -> seq_len > 1024
```
Elena Park: Customer traffic pattern shows a sudden batch of long-context requests from Aurora's analytics pipeline. They routed a large batched job 12:16UTC. That matches the timeline.
Julie Kline: Notifying Aurora account team. Julie -> Aurora SRE on call (cc'ing). Aurora SRE: can you confirm if they started any large jobs?
Aurora SRE: Yes we kicked off a long-run embedding generation job at 12:15 to reindex storefront history. Didn't expect this to hit model-serving route but it did via backfill proxy.
Sam Cho: OK. Immediate plan: (1) divert Aurora tenant traffic off shared aurora-pool-3 to isolation pool (aurora-isol-1) or fallback smaller model; (2) scale up aurora-pool-3 hosts if isolation not possible; (3) throttle long-context requests. Which is fastest?
Priya Nair: Divert to isolation pool is fastest if capacity exists. I see aurora-isol-1 in EU-West has two spare GPU nodes. We can pin the tenant and re-route at the smart-router layer.
Mateo Ruiz: I'll trigger tenant pin and pool attach. Command: `redwoodctl pools attach-tenant --tenant aurora --pool aurora-isol-1`
Mateo Ruiz: Running now...
incident-bot: RUNBOOK ACTION: run `redwoodctl pools attach-tenant --tenant aurora --pool aurora-isol-1` (executor: Mateo Ruiz)
Mateo Ruiz: Command output: ```
Attaching tenant aurora -> aurora-isol-1...
Updating routing policy...
Warmup triggers: 2/2 nodes scheduled
Success: traffic will switch over in ~30s
```
Elena Park: Starting traffic shift. Watch p95/p99 closely. Also enabling prefix KV cache warm for the main model.
Sam Cho: p99 dropped to 2.1s within 45s after shift, p95 back to 1.2s. Good sign but still cautious.
Aurora SRE: We can pause the reindex job on our side to reduce load if needed. Holding for now since shift helped.
Julie Kline: I've informed Aurora customer ops that we're shifting them to an isolation pool; asking for confirmation on pausing the backfill.
Priya Nair: Two follow-ups: (A) we should roll back the recent model variant if it triggered KV behavior; (B) schedule a controlled restart of g-aurora-09 worker to clear memory fragmentation. Which do we want first?
Mateo Ruiz: Rollback is cheaper and immediate. Initiating canary rollback to previous model version for Aurora only (no global rollback). Command: `redwoodctl model rollback --tenant aurora --model v3.2 --to v3.1`
Mateo Ruiz: Rollback in progress...
incident-bot: ACTION LOG: model rollback requested by Mateo Ruiz at 12:26UTC (target -> v3.1, tenant-scoped).
Sam Cho: Rolling worker restart scheduled for g-aurora-09 in 5m to avoid concurrent restarts. Mateo, coordinate with oncall.
Mateo Ruiz: Restart done. g-aurora-09 worker came back clean; no OOMs in last 90s.
Priya Nair: Monitoring shows consistent p99 ~1.9s post-rollback + isolation. We'll keep aurora pinned to isolates for 2 hours to observe.
Aurora SRE: Thanks — we paused our backfill temporarily. We'll coordinate a staggered resume later.
Julie Kline: Customer message sent: "We detected the latency spike from a large reindex job. We've moved your traffic to an isolated pool and rolled back a recent model variant; we're monitoring and will update in 60 minutes."
Sam Cho: Quick risk note: isolation pool is limited capacity, if Aurora resumes full backfill it could saturate. Recommend quota throttle on long-context requests: `routerctl set-rate-limit --tenant aurora --route /v1/generate --max-qps 8`
Priya Nair: Applied rate limit. Confirmed via router metrics: token throughput for Aurora reduced ~70% on long-tail requests.
incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff at 13:00UTC to Priya Nair (night shift). Sam -> Priya handoff: Sam summarized actions and current state.
Sam Cho: Handoff: state=stabilized, isolation=aurora-isol-1, rollback=v3.1, throttles applied, customer paused backfill. Monitoring alerts silenced for this tenant for 30m.
Priya Nair: Acknowledged handoff. I'll own next-hour observations and escalate if p99 > 2.5s persists.
Elena Park: Postmortem TODOs: - validate model rollout gating for tenant-scoped KVs - improve smart-router detection of large batch jobs via path heuristics - add auto-isolation policy when queue depth crosses 90th percentile for 3 consecutive mins.
Julie Kline: I'll schedule customer follow-up call for 16:00UTC to go over RCA and mitigation plan.
Aurora SRE: Appreciate the quick response. We'll provide job metadata for future routing hints.
Sam Cho: Closing war room in Slack. Final check: p99=1.85s, p95=1.15s, CPU/GPU normal. Marking incident as mitigated, will convert to postmortem. :heavy_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> convert to postmortem. Reference id INC-2026-0537.
